meta_description: KYA-Energy Group's software in one place: try it, buy it, and manage everything from your account.
hero_title: KYA-Energy Group's software, all in one place.
hero_text: Tools born in the field in West Africa, to design, assess and monitor energy systems. Try them, buy them, and find everything in your account.
ksd_text: Design solar systems that are reliable and affordable: from the site to the single-line diagram, with two indicators to decide.
ksd_capture_alt: KYA-SolDesign financial assessment screen on the sample project
soon_text: Presentation to come. Leave your email to be told when it opens.
how_intro: One account for all KYA-Energy Group software.
how_try_text: Create your account and start the free trial of the software, once, from your account.
how_buy_text: Choose the edition, the duration and the number of seats. Pay with Mobile Money or card.
how_manage_text: Licences, seats, downloads, purchase invoices and support requests, in your account.
kya_text: An energy engineering and research company that builds its software from its own installations. What we sell here, we use first.
faq_account_q: Does one account work for all software?
faq_account_a: Yes. The same account gives access to trials, purchases and downloads for every product on KYA-EnergyMarket.
faq_pay_a: With Mobile Money or a bank card, through Semoa. Institutions can request a quote and pay by bank transfer.
faq_invoice_q: When will I get my invoice?
faq_invoice_a: Right after payment: the purchase invoice is emailed to you and stays in your account, under Purchase invoices.
faq_seats_q: Can I use a licence on several computers?
faq_seats_a: A licence has a number of seats. Buy several and assign them to your colleagues from your account.
foot_tagline: The marketplace for KYA-Energy Group software. ISO 9001:2015 certified.
sign_in_text: The customer account opens with the next version of KYA-EnergyMarket: licences, seats, downloads, purchase invoices and support.
not_found_text: This address does not exist, or no longer does. Go back home to find KYA-Energy Group's software.
auth_intro: Sign in or create your account in a minute.
auth_side_title: One account for all KYA-Energy Group software.
auth_terms: I accept the terms of sale and the privacy policy.
auth_magic_link: Get a sign-in link by email
auth_magic_sent: If an account exists for this address, a sign-in link has just been sent.
auth_error_exists: An account already exists with this email. Please sign in.
auth_error_password: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
auth_error_rate: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
auth_error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
account_licences_text: Your licences, trials and seats will appear here when sales open.
account_downloads_text: The software of your licences, in its latest version.
account_invoices_text: One invoice per payment, in your organisation's name.
account_support_text: Your requests and our answers, in one place.
org_company_text: Create your organisation: its licences, purchase invoices and members belong to it, even if you leave.
org_intro: The members who use your licences, and the name on your purchase invoices.
org_invite_link: Invitation link to share (valid for 7 days):
org_member_only: Only the owner can invite or remove members.
invite_text: You are invited to join {organization} on KYA-EnergyMarket.
invite_invalid: This invitation is no longer valid, or it was sent to another address. Sign in with the invited email.
admin_intro: The KYA team's space. Each section arrives with its specification.
admin_denied_text: This area is reserved for the KYA team.
admin_team_intro: KYA team accounts and their roles.
admin_only: Only a KYA administrator grants roles.
admin_error_account: No account with this email: the person must create an account first.
admin_error_last: The last administrator cannot be removed.
auth_check_body: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to activate your account: it is valid for 24 hours.
auth_check_resent: Sent again. Remember to check your spam folder.
auth_error_unverified: Your email address is not confirmed yet. We just sent you the link again.
auth_error_link: This link is no longer valid. Sign in to receive a new one.
auth_password_changed: Password saved. Sign in with the new one.
pwd_intro: Enter your email: we'll send you a link to choose a new one.
pwd_sent: If an account exists for this address, a link has just been sent. It is valid for 1 hour.
pwd_new_intro: Choose a password of at least 10 characters. Your other sessions will be signed out.
pwd_invalid: This link is no longer valid: it works once and expires after 1 hour. Ask for a new one.
pwd_unavailable: Password reset by email is not available yet. Contact support.
org_invite_sent: Invitation emailed to {email}. You can also share this link (valid for 7 days):
consent_intro: {client} asks to act on KYA-EnergyMarket on your behalf, with your KYA team rights.
consent_scopes: What the client will be able to do
consent_scope_offline_access: Stay connected without asking again (until revoked)
consent_scope_admin_read: Read what the KYA team administers: team, customer accounts
consent_note: You can withdraw this authorization at any time in Administration → MCP.
consent_denied_text: The KYA-EnergyMarket MCP server is for administering the platform. Your account has no KYA team role: deny the request.
consent_error: The request has expired or is no longer valid. Start the connection again from your client.
admin_mcp_intro: Administer the platform from Claude or Codex. KYA team only; every call is logged.
admin_mcp_claude: Claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, then paste the address. Claude opens the site sign-in, then the authorization page.
admin_mcp_tool_whoami: your identity, roles and granted scopes
admin_mcp_tool_list_staff: the KYA team and its roles
admin_mcp_tool_find_customer: search a customer account by email or name
admin_mcp_revoked: Authorization withdrawn: this client is refused from its next call.
catalog_intro: Each piece of software has its page, pricing, resources and support. One account for all.
content_fallback: This page is not available in English yet: here is the French version.
content_preview_draft: Draft preview — visible to the KYA team only, not published yet.
content_preview_published: Preview — no draft in progress: you are seeing the published version.
block_pricing_single_seat: This edition is for a single seat.
block_pricing_seat_note: One seat = one computer. You assign seats to colleagues from your space.
admin_catalog_intro: Software, editions, durations and prices. Every change applies at once to pages, the API and MCP.
admin_catalog_read_only: Read-only: your role cannot change the catalogue.
admin_catalog_product_intro: Sheet, features, editions and durations. Prices are whole FCFA amounts, per seat.
admin_catalog_features_help: The key is fixed by the software (for example sizing.optimize): it is carried in the licence. Only the label is translated.
admin_pages_intro: Pages composed of blocks, per language. A draft is public only once published.
admin_editor_state_draft: Draft v{version} in progress: the public page changes only when published.
admin_editor_state_published: Version v{version} published. Editing creates a draft.
admin_editor_restored: Version restored as a draft: review it, then publish.
admin_editor_invalid: Save refused: check the fields shown.
admin_editor_stale: The draft changed meanwhile: reload the page before publishing.
admin_media_intro: Page images. They are converted to WebP and require alternative text.
admin_media_file_help: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, 12 MB at most. Reduced to 2,400 px wide.
admin_media_too_large: Image too large (12 MB at most).
admin_media_unsupported: This file is not an accepted image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF).
consent_scope_admin_catalog: Change the catalogue: software, editions, durations and prices
consent_scope_admin_content: Write and publish the site's pages
admin_mcp_tool_catalog: read the catalogue and a software offer
admin_mcp_tool_catalog_write: change a software, an edition, a duration's price (admin:catalog scope)
admin_mcp_tool_pages_write: write a page draft and publish it (admin:content scope)
